### 2026-10-25 – Oct 24- PCB design and capacitive touch

**5.6h**

Oct 24- PCB design and capacitive touch

(Writing this day late because I didn't have time lol)

What I did today was: first, I imported all my footprints into the design editor, and then I got started on the capacitive touch keys.

 My first iteration. I decided to use circles for a creative design.
![h](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/965730a3e121075e5dfef3ccc5eab957a31445ee0eb771bd45e8df99b549d17a.png)

Changed the circle diameter to 22mm because I needed to balance PCB size and touch size so I could actually use it.
![hi](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/70254679705fdf398513193f7bc278ffc5f3988a645061fa6903a12401b2a449.png)

Placing my first prototype on the PCB. Right away i realized it was too big, and i spent a lot more time balancing size and several more designs.
![hih](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/c78d5608d7243c6407f8abd0bf046968892f8990d4eb0e8c20dc80d84c9a3263.png)

Another design.
![hihi](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/c4325cf3af83cc0636ce946939c8cb2921977daee057b37ab9531139924d0606.png)

Finally, once I had the design for the keys I liked, I began rearranging components.
